title: Copilot Studio: agent node runs an AI agent as a workflow step
summary: Hold: the briefing understates the documented scope of Work IQ governance. Microsoft documents centralized Work IQ MCP governance for Work IQ in Copilot Studio, so the statement that its applicability is unconfirmed should be replaced. The roadmap facts and the listed allocation and consumption API operations are supported.
